Stage.LogText: {=sp_gt2_s1_log}Having severed {Dost_Name}'s foreign buyers, the Shadow Roost demands the purge of his war-profiteering syndicate inside the realm. Track down merchant financier {Muhbir1_Link}, who fenced the stolen Pigeon ciphers and funded {Dost_Name}'s grain blockades since your earliest trials, and silence him forever.

{=sp_gt2_s2_log}{Muhbir1_Link} will fund no more blockades. Now seek out {Dost_Name}'s underworld broker {Muhbir2_Link}, the gang leader who supplied the false-flag looters and frontier deserters behind your old slanders and {Dost_Name}'s staged raids, and dismantle his ring.
{=sp_gt2_s2_fight_log}{Muhbir2_Link}'s 30 mercenary enforcers ({CeteMuhafizlari_Link}) have ambushed you in the back streets! Cut through them to complete the underworld purge.
{=sp_gt2_fail_cete_log}The underworld thugs overwhelmed your forces in the back alleys. The purge of the conspirators fell apart in chaos.

Action.Title: {=sp_gt2_inq_defeat_title}Purge Ambush Defeat
Action.Text: {=sp_gt2_fail_cete_log}The underworld thugs overwhelmed your forces in the back alleys. The purge of the conspirators fell apart in chaos.

Stage.LogText: {=sp_gt2_s3_log}With his financier and underworld broker purged, {Dost_Name}'s hidden war machine inside the kingdom lies in ruins. Cornered at last, your former patron awaits a final reckoning. Confront {Dost_Link} face-to-face and end his betrayal once and for all!

{=sp_gt2_s3_battle_log}Unmasking himself at last, {Dost_Name} loosed his 75-strong elite execution force ({DostOrdusu_Link}) upon you! Crush {DostOrdusu_Link} in battle and end {Dost_Name}'s reign of deceit forever!
{=sp_gt2_fail_dost_log}{Dost_Name}'s elite Shadow Host overwhelmed your company on the battlefield. Left bleeding in the dust, your war against the puppet master ended in defeat.

Action.Title: {=sp_gt2_inq_dost_defeat_title}Crushed by the Shadow Host
Action.Text: {=sp_gt2_fail_dost_log}{Dost_Name}'s elite Shadow Host overwhelmed your company on the battlefield. Left bleeding in the dust, your war against the puppet master ended in defeat.

Stage.LogText: {=sp_gt2_s_success_log}You broke {Dost_Name}'s Shadow Host and cut the fallen mastermind down amidst his shattered ambush. The false slanders and manufactured wars are avenged. The Shadow Roost grants you 50,000 denars and 50 renown, inviting you to the final council.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_gt2_dlg1}You... You are {Dost_Name}'s former blade who burned the foreign exchange near the pass! Stay back! I only bought the ciphers and financed the grain blockades because he ordered it!
{=sp_gt2_dlg1_p}I know about the Pigeon ciphers you fenced and the war gold you laundered for {Dost_Name}.
{=sp_gt2_dlg1_reply}Mercy! Was it the Shadow Roost that sent you?! {Dost_Name} swore nobody could trace the laundered cipher accounts back to his banner! I burned all the ledgers, spare my life!
{=sp_gt2_dlg_m1_p1_inq}How long has {Dost_Name} been using the Scavenger Pigeons to turn fabricated slanders and border panics into silver?
{=sp_gt2_dlg_m1_p1_prag}Talk fast if you want a clean death. How did {Dost_Name}'s gold machine work inside our own kingdom?
{=sp_gt2_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt2_dlg_m1_a2}Ever since he took control of the outer cells! Every 'treason rumor' he whispered into noble ears, every loyalty test he staged like yours, was only the curtain! Behind it, he leaks garrison schedules to outsiders, buys up grain before a crisis, and sells mercenaries to the same lords he terrifies!
{=sp_gt2_dlg_m1_p2_ask}And who hires the cutthroats who frame loyal men and burn caravans to sell his 'protection'?
{=sp_gt2_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_gt2_dlg_m1_a3}{Muhbir2_Link} in the alleys handles the dirty steel, recruiting false-flag looters and deserters on {Dost_Name}'s silver! I was just his accountant! Take my chest keys, let me go!
{=sp_gt2_dlg2}Your blood money starved entire provinces and fueled {Dost_Name}'s lies. Silence is your only fate. (Execute the Financier)
{=sp_gt2_dlg3}Hand over the vault keys first, then face your doom. (Extort 15,000 denars & Execute)
{=sp_gt2_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_gt2_dlg4}Well, well... The stray Pigeon who turned coat! Word reached my alley that {Muhbir1_Name}'s ledgers are soaked in red. Did you really think I wouldn't know you were coming?
{=sp_gt2_dlg4_p}{Muhbir1_Name} gave up your name before he died. The Shadow Roost requires your silence, gang master.
{=sp_gt2_dlg4_reply}That soft-bellied merchant cracked under one threat? Doesn't matter. {Dost_Name} warned us days ago that an ungrateful dog slipped his leash!
{=sp_gt2_dlg_m2_p1_inq}So it was your street scum posing as looters to spread fake slanders and raid border villages under {Dost_Name}'s silver?
{=sp_gt2_dlg_m2_p1_prag}You hired the deserters and cutthroats behind every false war. Where is your master hiding?
{=sp_gt2_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt2_dlg_m2_a2}Every fake raid, every panicked caravan, every decoy band along the frontier ran through my boys! Gold is gold, Pigeon, and {Dost_Name} pays double for chaos! Enough talk. Boys, bar the exits and carve this wretch up!
{=sp_gt2_dlg5}Shadows swallow the alleys. Die with your lies! (Attack)
{=sp_gt2_dlg_thugs_intro}You butchered our boss in cold blood! None of you leave this street alive!
{=sp_gt2_dlg_thugs_p1}Your boss made his choice, and now you will join him! (Fight)
{=sp_gt2_dlg_thugs_p2}Clear the street or die where you stand! (Fight)
{=sp_gt2_dlg6_p}We meet again, {Dost_Name}. It seems our paths end here.

{=sp_gt2_dlg6_intro}{PlayerName}... First my merchant financier, then my enforcers in the alleys. You used the Shadow Roost's blades to carve through my entire network. Did you think I wouldn't see your treason looming behind me?

{=sp_gt2_dlg6_intro}{PlayerName}... First my merchant financier, then my enforcers in the alleys. You used the Shadow Roost's blades to carve through my entire network. Did you think I wouldn't see your treason looming behind me?

{=sp_gt2_dlg_p1_inq}You built our alliance on a staged slander from the very first day, {Dost_Name}. I carried your ciphers across the realm while you traded innocent lives. How long were you using me?
{=sp_gt2_dlg_p1_direct}I uncovered the stolen ciphers, the Black Ledger, and the hired raiders you funded. Your web of lies has unraveled.
{=sp_gt2_dlg_p1_prag}You turned the Scavenger Pigeons into a personal slaughterhouse for gold. Is this how the Motherland treats its loyal blades?
{=sp_gt2_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_gt2_dlg6_reply}Ever since you refused to silence that traitor when I marked him for death, my eyes were upon you... You shall pay for your betrayal with your life!
{=sp_gt2_dlg_p2_truth}You call sparing a witness treason? Treason was setting Calradia on fire so your Pigeons could sell the ashes!
{=sp_gt2_dlg_p2_accuse}I read the sealed orders bearing your mark! You starved loyalist clans with rigged grain blockades and incited false border raids for profit!
{=sp_gt2_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt2_dlg_dost_statecraft}You fool... You understand nothing of statecraft! Kings and emperors are arrogant toddlers who would drown Calradia in blood for sport. The Pigeons control the flow of wars so the realm survives in balance! Without our guided hand, chaos would swallow everything!
{=sp_gt2_dlg_p3_heroic}Balance? You call slaughtering innocents balance?! You are not a protector, {Dost_Name}, you are a cancer on the Motherland.
{=sp_gt2_dlg7}You are weak, {Dost_Name}. Your courts, your kings, and your lies only protect the weak. Pigeons do not soar in the skies, they feast above tombs.
{=sp_gt2_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_gt2_dlg_dost_battlecry}Then words are finished. If you will not bow to the Motherland's necessity, you will die in the dirt. Shadow Host, cut this traitor down!
{=sp_gt2_dlg7_heroic}For the true Calradia! Today the Motherland is freed from your poison! (Draw Steel & Charge)
{=sp_gt2_dlg7_dark}Draw your sword, puppet master! No cage will save you now! (Attack)
{=sp_gt2_dlg_host_intro}For {Dost_Name}! Cut them down!
{=sp_gt2_dlg_host_p1}Draw steel! (Fight)
{=sp_gt2_dlg_host_p2}Tell your master he falls next! (Fight)
